name: Cleveland
operatingHours: RTA Red Line runs ~4:00 AM–~12:30 AM daily, every ~15 min on weekdays and ~20–30 min evenings and weekends. The Blue and Green lines run ~4:30 AM–~12:30 AM between Tower City and Shaker Heights, every ~15–30 min. The Waterfront section (Settlers Landing–South Harbor) runs only for Browns home games. No overnight service.
fareInfo: RTA fare $2.50 per ride on rail and bus (2026), all-day pass $5; seniors, disabled riders and children 6–12 $1.25, under 6 free. Pay with the EZfare or Transit app (scan the validator when boarding), or buy at station ticket machines, which take cards. Cash is exact change only. Same fare to the airport.

hotels.name: Cleveland Marriott Downtown at Key Tower
Crowne Plaza Cleveland at Playhouse Square

sights.name: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame
sights.note: I. M. Pei's glass pyramid on the lakefront, packed with guitars, stage costumes and handwritten lyrics; a big new wing is due to open around December 2026, and the museum stays open during the work.
sights.hours: Daily 10:00 AM–5:00 PM, Thu till 9:00 PM (Sep–Jun); adults $45, cashless

sights.name: West Side Market
sights.note: A 1912 market hall under a vaulted tile ceiling and clock tower in Ohio City, with butchers, bakers and stalls selling pierogi, crepes and gyros.
sights.hours: Mon, Wed, Fri, Sat 8:00 AM–5:00 PM; Sun 10:00 AM–4:00 PM; closed Tue, Thu

sights.name: Cleveland Museum of Art
sights.note: One of the country's great encyclopedic art museums, from armour and Egyptian antiquities to Monet and Picasso, set above the Wade Park lagoon; the permanent collection is free.
sights.hours: Tue, Thu, Sat, Sun 10:00 AM–5:00 PM; Wed, Fri till 9:00 PM; closed Mon

sights.name: A Christmas Story House
sights.note: The Tremont house where the 1983 holiday film was shot, restored to match the movie (leg lamp included), with a small museum of props across the street.
sights.hours: Daily 10:00 AM–5:00 PM, longer around Thanksgiving and Christmas; from ~$20

sights.name: Cleveland Metroparks Zoo
sights.note: A big hillside zoo south of downtown with an African savanna, a rainforest building and the Asian Highlands; take a bus or taxi, it isn't near a rail stop.
sights.hours: Oct–Mar 10:00 AM–4:00 PM; Apr–Sep 10:00 AM–5:00 PM

sights.name: Lake View Cemetery and Garfield Memorial
sights.note: A hilly Victorian garden cemetery where President Garfield lies in an ornate memorial tower with a balcony view to the lake; Rockefeller and Eliot Ness are buried here too.
sights.hours: Gates ~7:30 AM–5:30 PM (later in summer); Garfield Memorial 10:00 AM–4:00 PM daily until 20 Nov 2026

sights.name: USS Cod Submarine Memorial
sights.note: A World War II submarine moored on the lakefront that you board the original way, down ladders and through hatches, past torpedoes and bunks.
sights.hours: Daily 10:00 AM–5:00 PM, Apr–Nov; winter visits weather permitting

sights.name: Progressive Field
sights.note: The Guardians' downtown ballpark, with skyline views from the upper deck and a lively district of bars around it on game nights.
sights.hours: Guardians home games Apr–Sep; ballpark tours on select dates

sights.name: Cleveland Botanical Garden
sights.note: Ten acres of themed gardens in University Circle plus a glasshouse with a Madagascar spiny desert and a Costa Rican cloud forest full of butterflies.
sights.hours: Tue–Sat 10:00 AM–5:00 PM; Sun noon–5:00 PM; closed Mon

sights.name: Cleveland Museum of Natural History
sights.note: Freshly rebuilt galleries of dinosaurs, Ohio wildlife and gems, plus the famous 'Lucy' fossil cast and a live-animal centre.

sights.name: Cleveland Arcade
sights.note: An 1890 five-storey shopping arcade with a glass roof and brass railings between Euclid and Superior, now the lobby of a Hyatt with cafés on the ground floor.
sights.hours: Concourse open daily, roughly daytime to evening; free

sights.name: Little Italy
sights.note: A few hilly blocks of Mayfield Road with old bakeries, Italian restaurants and art galleries, a short walk up from the Little Italy–University Circle Red Line station.
sights.hours: Restaurants lunch to late; Feast of the Assumption mid-August

sights.name: Great Lakes Science Center
sights.note: A hands-on science museum beside the Rock Hall with a NASA space gallery and a domed cinema; the moored freighter Steamship William G. Mather is part of the ticket.
sights.hours: Daily 10:00 AM–5:00 PM, Thu till 8:00 PM; closed on Browns home game days

sights.name: Edgewater Park
sights.note: A lakeshore park with a sandy beach, a pier and the best free view of the downtown skyline across the water, especially at sunset.

sights.name: Severance Music Center
sights.note: The Art Deco home of the Cleveland Orchestra, one of America's top orchestras, with a gilded concert hall that is worth seeing even on a tour.
sights.hours: Orchestra season Sep–May; check concert dates

sights.name: Cleveland Public Library
sights.note: The grand 1925 main library on Superior Avenue, with a reading garden between its two buildings and free exhibits of rare books and maps.

sights.name: Playhouse Square
sights.note: The country's largest theatre district outside New York, five restored 1920s halls on Euclid Avenue under a giant outdoor chandelier.
sights.hours: Chandelier and street always open; show times vary

sights.name: East 4th Street
sights.note: A short pedestrian lane of restaurants and bars under strung lights, the easiest dinner-and-drinks stop downtown before a game.

railStations.name: Cleveland Lakefront Station
railStations.note: Amtrak's small lakefront station on the Shoreway, below the Browns stadium. The Lake Shore Limited (Chicago–New York/Boston) and the Floridian (Chicago–Washington–Miami) stop here. Tower City is a ~15-minute walk; the Waterfront Line flag stop only runs on Browns game days, so take a taxi at night.
railStations.hours: About 4 trains a day, all between ~1:50 AM and ~5:50 AM; waiting room opens around train times.

airports.name: Cleveland Hopkins International Airport
airports.transitNote: The Red Line (on this map) starts at the Airport station on the terminal's lower level and reaches Tower City downtown in under 30 min for the $2.50 fare. A taxi or rideshare takes ~20–25 min.
airports.hours: Red Line: first ~4:00 AM, last ~12:30 AM.
